# Lab 4.2: Joins & UNNEST

## What We Are Going to Do
Write inner, left, cross, semi and anti joins, and join an array to its parent row with UNNEST.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Inner and left joins.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT u.id, u.first_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` u
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` o ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.country = 'India'
GROUP BY u.id, u.first_name
ORDER BY orders
LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Users with `0` orders appear only because of the `LEFT JOIN`.

2. **[SQL] Semi join (EXISTS) and anti join (NOT EXISTS).**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">-- Products that have been sold
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i WHERE i.product_id = p.id);

-- Products never sold
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i WHERE i.product_id = p.id);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Cross join to build combinations.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT d AS day, s AS status
FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY('2026-01-01', '2026-01-03')) AS d
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(['Shipped', 'Returned']) AS s;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Correlated UNNEST join.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT order_id, item.product_id, item.sale_price
FROM lab02.orders_nested, UNNEST(items) AS item
LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>

   If you skipped Module 2, use any table with an ARRAY column.

5. **[Console] Compare join plans.** Open **Execution graph** for step 1. Look for a **JOIN** stage and whether it says **HASH** or **BROADCAST**.

6. **[CLI] Run the anti join from bq.**

</code></pre>

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| LEFT JOIN | Keeps users without orders |
| EXISTS / NOT EXISTS | Semi and anti joins |
| CROSS JOIN | Every combination (6 rows) |
| UNNEST join | One row per array element |
